title: Nimble Chinese White Yam Yangzhou Fried Rice
description: A quick-fix Chinese dish featuring white yam and wok-hei, flexitarian-friendly and made in a tava-griddle, with a mustardy and crispy texture.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a tava-griddle over medium-high heat.
Add the mustard seeds and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add the chopped scallions and cook until they are slightly softened.
Add the diced white yam and cook until they are lightly browned and crispy.
Push the yam and scallion mixture to one side of the griddle.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the other side of the griddle.
Add the cooked rice to the griddle and stir-fry until it is heated through and starting to brown.
Mix the rice with the yam and scallion mixture, and add the soy sauce, salt, and pepper.
Stir-fry everything together for another minute, until the rice is crispy and golden brown.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
